newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker up, 180-cst/380-cst spread widened.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker up, 180-cst/380-cst spread widened.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Thursday were notionally higher with the spread between 180-cst and 380-cst seen widening, traders said
Bunker 180-cst were quoted ranging between at $129-$131 and 380-cst at $121-$124 per tonne.

The spread between the two grades has widened to $7-$8 from the previous $6-$7 per tonne, traders said, citing the rise in gas oil prices. Gas oil are used to cut the viscosity of 280-cst or 380-cst fuel oil down to 180-cst.
MDO remained steady quoted at $238-$245 and gas oil at $248-$253.
